overview.description: The iShares Texas Equity ETF (TEXN) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell Texas Equity index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index that invests in equity securities of companies headquartered in Texas. The fund aims to capitalize on Texas business and population growth.rn TEXN was launched on Jun 23, 2025 and is issued by BlackRock.
